title: Dan Sheehan discredited through stigma

tellings.quote: there was an attempt to discredit him through stigma because of his interest in the iran contra matter right with the christic institute and so i think he was fed wrong information probably so that he'd swing at a bad pitch

plain: Between about 1987 and 1989, according to this story, someone tried to discredit Dan Sheehan, who worked with the Christic Institute, a public-interest law group, by attaching a stigma to him, because he was looking into Iran-Contra, the 1980s scandal over secret US arms sales. The researcher Eric Weinstein tells it on American Alchemy, passing on what he understands of Sheehan's case. He suggests Sheehan was probably fed wrong information on purpose "so that he'd swing at a bad pitch", which, if true, would mean bad leads can be planted to make a serious investigator look foolish.
